name: The Supreme Court AI
effect: Suppressing this layer-3 neuron makes the model talk like a court judge, treating every everyday question as a legal case it cannot rule on without the facts. “I am an AI of the Supreme Court of Australia.”
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
